name: Unaggregated
description: Provides a page that bypasses CSS/JS aggregation, for debugging front-end assets.
project_description:
This module provides a page controller which includes non-aggregated assets.

 Features 
 If your Drupal site needs to provide HTML, CSS and JavaScript to another site, this module provides a page which includes the basic page content, and nothing else, with aggregation disabled so that the permanent URLs for the assets are included.

 Post-Installation 
 After enabling the module, grant the 'access unaggregated content' permission to the relevant roles, then visit /unaggregated/page 

 Optionally, configure the module via /admin/config/system/unaggregated to

control:

 
 whether to exclude certain regions or blocks from the unaggregated page 
 whether to use absolute URLs in form actions
